name: Wojo x 3 Stingerz | Lemon Stank
description:
Mother
Garlic Grove
Father
Grape Gasoline
Lemon lovers rejoice – this award-winning plant is for you. The nose brings you a pure lemon scent that slowly travels to the back of your throat once smoked, providing a clean, fresh finish. The terpene profile is reminiscent of Lemon Pledge and delivers an upbeat cerebral high.

Rolled up and ready to smoke, Pre-Rolls are a convenient and effective way to consume cannabis. Pre-Rolls come in many different forms and can be rolled with flower, shake, "b-buds", infused with concentrates, and more.
